ownedComment.body: A CItsZone reference to detection, relevance and associated zone is provided for any Section Intrisecally in the CLM sub-segment the relevance Zones are intrinsecally associated to the sub-segment location by a CItsZoneGroup reference Several C ITS zone Group are needed as there are constraints under which a C ITS zones can be defined and associated to GLC Container in a C ITS message, so we keep an option to reference several C ITS Zone Group by each individual sub-segments. C ITS zone group reference for lanes are considered the same as the corresponding sub-segments.

from C ROADS C-ITS MessageProfiles_2.0.9
In the I2V use case scenario, the DF eventPosition is used to locate lane or carriageway blockings or hazardous locations. It represents the position where the physical blockage on the lane (including hard shoulder) or the carriageway or the hazardous location starts. In case of blockages by trailers, it depends on the national regulation in individual member states whether the blockage is the trailer itself or the first cone in front of the trailer. The accuracy should be on the level of a lane, but shall at least be on the accuracy level of the carriageway.

a number of traces (for C ITS DENM depending on overal DENM message length ) can be associated to a specific network location based on possible path for a vehicle leading to the network location which is assumed to be the Event Position and Extent of a Situation related to a DENM message
any DENM message has a maximum number of traces available, if this number is exceeded several DENM messages need to be generated for all traces
up to 7 traces are allowed in a C ITS messages up to 40 point are allowed for a trace as C ITS PathHistory which is equivalent to DATEX II GmlLineString
Event Zone is expressed as GmlLineString taking care that DENM message allows up to 23 point to be addressed in Event Zone expressed as delta position

C ITS IVIM Location Extended can be specified
- on the base of a C ITS Zone Group which is included and then Zone are referenced from the group reference fo the different awarenes, detection and relevance zones, which construct is convenient to support GLC container information
- specific C ITS Zones can be defined by themselves not referring to a C ITS Zone Group, even if when delivering an IVIM these need to be combined as GLC container

- a CItsDenmSection is used to specify the location or event reference position and the associated traces. - multeplicty more then 1 is needed for extended linear location associated more then DENM allow. so that a number of event position is defined each one of them has traces associated.
- in case of NetworkLocation being LInear location a section offset is used so that it's not needed to specify a further location to define the C ITS DENM Section - a CItsDenmSection is also a network location but this is not needed to build C ITS messages, so the further relation to network location is optional

A C ITS Zone group corresponde in C ITS IVIM to GLC container which refer all Zone used in a IVIM message
up to 16 Zones are allowed for C ITS GLC
